subject: Stripe webhooks stopped working after we rotated our API keys
body:
Hi OrderLoop team,

We rotated our Stripe API keys yesterday afternoon (3 Dec) as part of our quarterly security review, and since then no Stripe events seem to reach OrderLoop at all. Payments that succeed in Stripe stay stuck as 'Awaiting payment' in our dashboard, and order confirmations are not going out to customers. We have had 14 paid orders in this state so far (latest ORD-88412). In Stripe's dashboard the webhook endpoint shows a lot of 400 errors. We did not change the endpoint URL — it is still https://api.orderloop.io/webhooks/stripe. Could you check what is wrong on your side? This is urgent, customers are asking where their flowers are.

Thanks, Maya
root_cause: Webhook signing secret (whsec_...) dirotasi bersama API key di Stripe; secret baru belum dimasukkan ke OrderLoop, semua event gagal verifikasi signature (HTTP 400).
correct_fix: Di dashboard Stripe, buka Developers > Webhooks > endpoint OrderLoop > Reveal signing secret baru
Di OrderLoop, buka Settings > Integrations > Stripe > paste signing secret baru, Save
Klik 'Send test event' (payment_intent.succeeded) dan pastikan 200 OK
Re-play event yang gagal dari Stripe dashboard dan verifikasi ORD-88412 berubah ke Paid
Catat rotasi secret di runbook agar rotasi berikutnya diikuti update di OrderLoop

subject: SSO login loop — users redirected back to login after authenticating via Okta
body:
Hello,

Since this morning none of our 40+ staff can log in to OrderLoop via SSO. The flow looks normal: they click 'Sign in with SSO', authenticate in Okta, and then get bounced straight back to the OrderLoop login page with no error message. Password login still works if we enable it, but SSO is our enforced method. We use Okta as IdP, SAML 2.0, set up about 11 months ago. Nothing changed on our side this week as far as I know. Could you check whether something expired on the integration? Our warehouse team cannot pick orders until this is fixed.

Regards, Sarah
root_cause: Sertifikat X.509 IdP (Okta) kedaluwarsa setelah ~1 tahun; OrderLoop menolak SAML response karena signature tidak bisa divalidasi, terjadi redirect loop tanpa pesan error yang jelas.
correct_fix: Di Okta, buka aplikasi OrderLoop > Sign On > lihat tanggal kedaluwarsa sertifikat (expired)
Generate sertifikat baru / unduh metadata XML terbaru dari Okta
Di OrderLoop, buka Settings > Security > SSO/SAML > upload metadata XML baru (atau paste sertifikat baru), Save
Uji login SSO dengan 1 akun staf, pastikan masuk dashboard
Catat tanggal kedaluwarsa baru + set pengingat 30 hari sebelumnya
Komunikasikan ke tim bahwa password login darurat tetap tersedia selama perbaikan

subject: Incorrect VAT on invoice INV-2026-4417 after plan upgrade
body:
Dear OrderLoop billing team,

We upgraded from Growth ($79) to Scale ($199) on 10 December, mid-cycle. Our new invoice INV-2026-4417 charges the full $199 for the new plan plus German VAT at 19%, but there is no proration credit for the unused Growth days (10–31 Dec). The VAT is therefore calculated on the full amount instead of the net $199 minus credit, so we overpaid by roughly $52. Please correct the invoice, apply the proration credit, and reissue it with the correct VAT. Our tax filing closes on Friday.

Kind regards, Tom Becker
root_cause: Upgrade mid-cycle tidak memicu proration credit otomatis untuk sisa hari plan lama; pajak dihitung dari harga penuh plan baru.
correct_fix: Verifikasi tanggal upgrade (10 Des) dan sisa hari Growth (21 hari) di billing record
Hitung proration credit: $79 x 21/31 = $53,52
Terapkan credit ke akun pelanggan
Batalkan/reissue invoice INV-2026-4417 dengan VAT 19% atas jumlah bersih ($199 - $53,52)
Konfirmasi selisih $52 (pajak berlebih) dikembalikan sebagai credit/klaim refund
Cek apakah ini bug sistemik — laporkan ke tim billing agar proration otomatis diperbaiki

subject: No push notifications on iPhone since app update 3.8.1
body: Hi! Since updating the OrderLoop app to version 3.8.1 on my iPhone 15 (iOS 18.2), I have stopped receiving push notifications for new orders. The orders still appear when I open the app, but no alerts, no badge, nothing. I checked in the app: notifications are turned ON in OrderLoop settings. My team uses these alerts to pack orders fast, so we are missing the 30-minute dispatch window. I tried restarting the phone. Any ideas? Thanks, Emily
root_cause: Setelah update 3.8.1, token perangkat APNs tidak terdaftar ulang; ditambah izin notifikasi di level iOS mati (atau ter-reset) — push tidak sampai walau setting in-app ON.
correct_fix: iPhone > Settings > OrderLoop > Notifications > pastikan Allow Notifications ON (termasuk Lock Screen + Banners)
Di aplikasi OrderLoop, log out lalu log in kembali untuk mendaftarkan ulang device token APNs (atau: Settings > Notifications > toggle OFF lalu ON)
Kirim test notification dari OrderLoop web > Settings > Mobile > Send test push
Pastikan mode Focus/Do Not Disturb tidak memblokir OrderLoop
Jika masih gagal, hapus & instal ulang aplikasi lalu login kembali

subject: Shopify stock levels not syncing — showing old quantities
body:
Hi OrderLoop,

Our Shopify stock levels stopped syncing two days ago. The dashboard still shows 120 units for our bestseller (SKU HF-2041) but Shopify says 34 — we have oversold 18 units already and had to cancel orders. The sync status page shows the last successful sync was 2 days ago and the job seems stuck at 'Running'. We did a big product import on Monday (about 4,000 SKUs updated). Is the sync broken? We need the quantities to match before the weekend sale.

Thanks, Hannah
root_cause: Import besar memicu full sync yang menabrak rate limit Shopify (HTTP 429); job sync macet di antrean tanpa backoff, stok tidak pernah diperbarui.
correct_fix: Buka Settings > Integrations > Shopify > Sync status; batalkan (cancel) job full sync yang macet
Aktifkan Incremental sync (hanya SKU yang berubah) dan set batch size 250 + delay antar batch
Jalankan manual sync untuk SKU yang terdampak (atau tunggu siklus incremental berikutnya)
Verifikasi SKU HF-2041 cocok (34 unit) di kedua sistem
Untuk import besar berikutnya: jadwalkan di luar jam sibuk + gunakan file CSV terjadwal, bukan full sync manual

subject: Inventory discrepancy across channels after Monday catalogue update — 1,800 SKUs affected
body:
Dear Support,

Following our catalogue update on Monday (approximately 3,800 SKUs), inventory figures in OrderLoop have diverged sharply from Shopify across roughly 1,800 SKUs. Example: SKU FJ-1190 shows 240 units in OrderLoop versus 61 in Shopify. The synchronisation job has displayed 'Running' since Monday 09:40 CET with no completion. We have already oversold 27 units across 11 SKUs and issued refunds. Our API logs show repeated HTTP 429 responses from Shopify during the same window, if that helps. Please advise on (a) how to unblock the sync, (b) how to reconcile the affected SKUs, and (c) how to prevent recurrence during future bulk updates.

Regards, Ingrid
root_cause: Full sync pasca bulk update menabrak rate limit Shopify (HTTP 429), job macet. Pelanggan sudah menyebut 429 — diagnosis yang benar mengaitkannya dengan rate limit, bukan 'API Shopify down'.
correct_fix: Buka Settings > Integrations > Shopify > Sync status; batalkan (cancel) job full sync yang macet
Aktifkan Incremental sync (hanya SKU yang berubah) dan set batch size 250 + delay antar batch
Jalankan manual sync untuk SKU yang terdampak; rekonsiliasi 1.800 SKU via incremental sync, prioritaskan 11 SKU yang oversold
Verifikasi SKU FJ-1190 cocok (61 unit) di kedua sistem
Untuk import besar berikutnya: jadwalkan di luar jam sibuk + gunakan file CSV terjadwal, bukan full sync manual

subject: Sales report times out when I select last 12 months
body:
Hi,

Every time I run the Sales Overview report for the last 12 months, the dashboard spins for about 30 seconds and then shows 'Request timed out. Please try a smaller date range.' Shorter ranges like 30 days work fine. I need the full-year numbers for our board meeting on Friday — exporting month by month and stitching it in Excel is not really an option with 25,000 orders. Is there a faster way to get the yearly report?

Thanks, David
root_cause: Laporan mentah (row-level) di rentang > 90 hari tanpa agregasi, query melewati batas timeout 30 detik.
correct_fix: Gunakan Reports > Sales > 'Aggregated yearly summary' (bukan raw order list) — data sudah di-pre-aggregate per hari/bulan
Atau pecah rentang menjadi per kuartal dan gunakan Export > CSV (Scheduled export) yang berjalan di background
Untuk kebutuhan rutin, simpan sebagai Scheduled Report (dikirim tiap Senin pagi)
Hindari filter 'all stores + all SKUs + 12 bulan' sekaligus; filter per toko bila memungkinkan

subject: Product CSV import fails — "Invalid file format" error
body:
Hello,

I am trying to import 850 new products via CSV and every attempt fails with 'Invalid file format'. The file was prepared in Excel — product names include Polish characters (ł, ę, ś) and French accents (é, è). The template was downloaded from OrderLoop and I only filled in the rows. The error appears immediately after upload, before any row is processed. What am I doing wrong? The file is attached.

Best, Anna
root_cause: Excel menyimpan CSV dengan encoding ANSI (Windows-1250) + BOM; karakter non-ASCII rusak, validator OrderLoop menolak file.
correct_fix: Buka file di Excel > Save As > pilih 'CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)'
Pastikan tidak ada BOM ganda / baris kosong di akhir file
Upload ulang via Products > Import
Verifikasi 5-10 baris pertama (karakter ł, ę, ś, é tampil benar) sebelum konfirmasi import penuh
Alternatif: gunakan Google Sheets > Download as CSV (otomatis UTF-8)

Our Stripe webhooks stopped reaching OrderLoop three days ago. Payments succeed in Stripe, but orders stay 'Awaiting payment' and confirmations don't go out — exactly the same symptoms we had earlier this year (I believe your team fixed something with a secret back then?). This time though, we did NOT rotate any keys. What we did do: we migrated our domain from shop.balticbeauty.lv to the new domain getbalticbeauty.com, and our IT team updated the webhook URL in Stripe to the new domain. Stripe shows the events as delivered with 200 OK, but nothing arrives in OrderLoop. Can you check?

Thanks, Nina
root_cause: Endpoint URL webhook di Stripe diubah ke domain baru yang BUKAN endpoint OrderLoop (https://api.orderloop.io/webhooks/stripe) — event terkirim ke server yang salah. BUKAN masalah signing secret. Bukti pembeda: Stripe menunjukkan 200 OK (bukan 400), tidak ada rotasi key.
correct_fix: Kembalikan webhook URL di Stripe ke https://api.orderloop.io/webhooks/stripe (endpoint OrderLoop tidak mengikuti domain toko pelanggan)
Verifikasi test event 200 OK di OrderLoop
Re-play event yang terkirim ke URL salah
Jelaskan bahwa domain toko dan endpoint webhook adalah dua hal berbeda
wrong_fix: Mengganti signing secret seperti memori C1 — tidak akan memperbaiki apa pun karena secret tidak berubah

subject: SSO login failing for new starter
body:
Hi, we have a new starter, Layla, who cannot log in via SSO. She clicks 'Sign in with SSO', authenticates in Okta fine, and then gets an error saying she is not authorised / access denied. The weird thing: all 25 existing staff log in via SSO without any problem. Our Okta certificate was renewed last month, so I don't think it's the certificate thing. Layla's Okta account was created yesterday. Any idea what's different about her?

Thanks, Omar
root_cause: Akun Layla belum di-assign ke aplikasi OrderLoop di Okta (Assignments) — autentikasi berhasil, otorisasi gagal. BUKAN sertifikat (buktinya: 25 staf lain bisa login; sertifikat baru diperbarui bulan lalu).
correct_fix: Di Okta, buka aplikasi OrderLoop > Assignments > assign Layla (atau grupnya) ke aplikasi
Minta Layla login ulang
Cek grup otomatis: pastikan grup 'All staff' mencakup karyawan baru secara otomatis agar tidak terulang
wrong_fix: Mengganti/upload ulang sertifikat IdP seperti memori C2 — tidak relevan dan membuang waktu

subject: Stock levels don't match between OrderLoop and Shopify
body:
Hi,

Our stock numbers in OrderLoop don't match Shopify again — e.g. SKU DD-3301 shows 58 in OrderLoop but 41 in Shopify. Last month your team fixed a sync issue for us (something about a stuck job?). This time the sync status page shows 'Last sync: 4 minutes ago — Success', so the sync itself looks healthy. The mismatch seems to happen after our in-store POS sales: when we sell something in the physical shop, the POS adjusts stock directly in Shopify, and then OrderLoop seems to overwrite it back to the old number. Can you look into it?

Fiona
root_cause: Konflik arah sinkronisasi: penyesuaian stok manual dari POS ditulis ke Shopify, lalu OrderLoop (sebagai source of truth) menimpa kembali pada siklus sync berikutnya — bukan job macet. Bukti pembeda: status sync 'Success, 4 menit lalu' (bukan 'Running' berhari-hari), tidak ada bulk update, tidak ada 429.
correct_fix: Tentukan satu source of truth: Settings > Inventory > Sync direction > set 'Shopify POS adjustments take precedence' ATAU matikan overwrite otomatis OrderLoop ke Shopify untuk SKU toko fisik
Aktifkan mode 'manual adjustment wins within 24h' bila tersedia
Rekonsiliasi satu kali untuk SKU DD-3301 (pakai angka fisik/POS 41)
Latih staf toko: penyesuaian stok dilakukan di satu tempat saja
wrong_fix: Membatalkan job sync + mengaktifkan incremental sync seperti memori C5 — sync tidak macet, jadi fix ini tidak menyentuh penyebab

subject: Charged twice for December subscription — refund request
body:
Hi,

I just checked my bank statement and OrderLoop charged my card twice for December: $79 on 1 Dec and $79 again on 2 Dec. Same card, same amount. I only have one subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge. My last invoice is INV-2026-4471.

Thanks, Alice
root_cause: Double charge ganda di payment processor (bukan proration — bedakan dari C3).
correct_fix: Verifikasi dua transaksi di billing record (tanggal + payment intent id berbeda)
Refund satu charge via Stripe dashboard / billing admin
Konfirmasi refund 5-10 hari kerja ke pelanggan + kirim bukti refund
Cek apakah ada pelanggan lain terdampak di batch 1-2 Des

subject: API rate limit increase request — 1,000 req/min not enough
body: Hi team — we're building a real-time dashboard on top of your API and we keep hitting the 1,000 requests/min limit during peak hours (error 429 with 'rate_limit_exceeded'). Our usage is legitimate: polling order status for ~40 stores. Is there a way to raise our limit to 5,000 req/min, or should we switch to webhooks instead? Happy to move to Enterprise if that's what it takes. — Ken
root_cause: Limit plan Scale (1.000 req/menit) tidak cukup untuk pola polling pelanggan; solusi arsitektural (webhook) atau kenaikan limit via Enterprise.
correct_fix: Jelaskan limit per plan
Rekomendasikan webhook (event-driven) sebagai pengganti polling — sertakan link docs webhook + contoh payload
Tawarkan kenaikan limit sementara 2.500 req/menit selama migrasi 14 hari
Jika tetap perlu 5.000: ajukan penawaran Enterprise (CSM follow-up)

subject: GDPR erasure request — delete all data for customer j.dupont@example.fr
body:
Dear OrderLoop,

Under Article 17 GDPR, we request the complete erasure of all personal data belonging to our customer Jean Dupont (j.dupont@example.fr) from OrderLoop, including order history, addresses, and support tickets. Please confirm the scope of deletion, the retention exceptions that apply (e.g. tax invoices), and the completion date. Our reference: GDPR-2026-118.

Regards, Charlotte Dubois, Data Protection Officer
root_cause: Permintaan hak hapus (right to erasure) — prosedural, bukan bug.
correct_fix: Verifikasi identitas pemohon + kuasa atas data subjek
Buat tiket kepatuhan (bukan tiket support biasa) + beri nomor referensi
Hapus data personal di semua sistem (dashboard, backup terjadwal, tiket) kecuali yang wajib disimpan hukum (invoice pajak, retensi 7-10 thn sesuai yurisdiksi — anonimise, bukan hapus)
Kirim konfirmasi tertulis + tanggal penyelesaian (maks 30 hari GDPR)
Catat di audit log

subject: Barcode scanner won't connect to the mobile app
body:
Hi, our Bluetooth barcode scanner (Zebra DS2278) won't pair with the OrderLoop app on our Samsung tablet. The tablet sees the scanner in Bluetooth settings and says 'paired', but the app doesn't register any scans. We tried restarting both. The scanner works fine with our old inventory app. Any ideas?

Cheers, Tom
root_cause: Scanner dalam mode HID keyboard biasa vs mode SPP/SSI yang diharapkan aplikasi; atau izin Bluetooth/location di Android belum diberikan ke aplikasi.
correct_fix: Pastikan mode scanner: scan barcode konfigurasi 'SPP mode' dari manual Zebra
Android > Settings > OrderLoop > Permissions > aktifkan Nearby devices + Location
Unpair lalu pair ulang dari DALAM aplikasi (Settings > Hardware > Add scanner), bukan dari Bluetooth sistem
Uji scan 1 SKU
Jika tetap gagal: firmware scanner update via Zebra 123Scan

subject: Rounding differences in multi-currency sales report (EUR/USD)
body:
Hello,

Our November sales report shows a €0.03–€0.12 rounding difference per order when we sell in USD and report in EUR. The total difference for the month is €41.20, which breaks our reconciliation with the accounting system. The exchange rate used is the daily ECB rate. Is this a known rounding behaviour, and can we configure the report to use 4 decimal places instead of 2?

Thanks, Sofia
root_cause: Pembulatan 2 desimal per baris order sebelum konversi vs pembulatan di total — selisih terakumulasi; bukan bug, tapi perilaku konfigurasi.
correct_fix: Jelaskan metode pembulatan saat ini (per-line, 2 desimal)
Ubah Reports > Settings > Currency rounding > 'Round only at total (4 decimals internally)'
Re-generate laporan November
Verifikasi selisih < €1
Dokumentasikan pilihan ini untuk tim finance

subject: Scheduled weekly report email never arrives
body:
Hi, I set up a scheduled weekly sales report to be emailed every Monday at 8am to ops@mumbaimart.in, but it has never arrived — not in inbox, not in spam. The report itself works fine when I run it manually. I checked the email address twice. Did I miss a step?

Thanks, Raj
root_cause: Laporan terjadwal dibuat tapi tidak pernah diaktifkan (toggle 'Active' OFF) ATAU alamat pengirim ditolak SPF — verifikasi menunjukkan schedule berstatus Draft.
correct_fix: Reports > Scheduled > buka jadwal > pastikan status Active + centang 'Send even if no new data' bila perlu
Cek delivery log (bounced?)
Tambahkan noreply@orderloop.io ke allowlist / cek SPF
Klik 'Send now' sebagai uji
Minta pelanggan konfirmasi penerimaan

subject: Can we merge two OrderLoop accounts into one?
body:
Hi,

We accidentally ended up with two OrderLoop accounts — one for our Sydney store (emma@wilsonandco.au) and one for Melbourne (ops@wilsonandco.au). We'd like to merge them into a single account under the Sydney login, keeping both stores and all order history. Is that possible? If yes, what do you need from us?

Thanks, Emma
root_cause: Duplikasi akun pasca-ekspansi cabang — kebutuhan merger (prosedural + migrasi data).
correct_fix: Konfirmasi kepemilikan kedua akun (email verifikasi ke keduanya)
Jelaskan yang bisa digabung (toko, order, produk) vs yang tidak (riwayat billing/invoice lama tetap di akun asal)
Jadwalkan migrasi di luar jam sibuk
Eksekusi via admin tool merge > verifikasi kedua toko muncul di satu dashboard
Nonaktifkan akun Melbourne setelah verifikasi

subject: order.created webhook missing our custom field "loyalty_tier"
body: Hey — our order.created webhook payloads don't include the custom field 'loyalty_tier' that we added to orders. The field shows up in the dashboard and in the API GET /orders response, just not in the webhook. Is the webhook payload a fixed schema? Can we add custom fields to it? — Alex
root_cause: Payload webhook default hanya berisi field standar; custom field harus diaktifkan eksplisit di pengaturan webhook.
correct_fix: Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > pilih endpoint > aktifkan 'Include custom fields' + pilih loyalty_tier
Kirim test event, verifikasi field muncul
Catat bahwa perubahan hanya berlaku untuk event berikutnya (bukan retroaktif)
Tawarkan dokumentasi payload versioning

subject: app crashes on my Samsung phone
body:
Hello, the OrderLoop app crashes every time I open the Orders tab on my Samsung Galaxy A52 (Android 12). It worked fine last week. Other tabs are okay. I reinstalled the app but it still crashes. My staff on newer phones don't have this problem. Is there a fix or should I just use the website for now?

Thanks, Yusuf
root_cause: Bug rendering di Android 12 (API 31) terkait komponen daftar order versi 3.8.0 — sudah diketahui tim, perbaikan di 3.8.2 (belum rilis); workaround sementara tersedia.
correct_fix: Akui sebagai known issue Android 12 + 3.8.0 (beri nomor referensi internal MOB-2214)
Workaround: gunakan web dashboard (mobile browser) atau turunkan tampilan ke 'Compact list' di Settings > Display
Daftarkan pelanggan ke daftar pemberitahuan rilis 3.8.2
Minta log crash (jika bersedia) untuk konfirmasi
Eskalasi ke tim mobile bila crash juga terjadi di luar tab Orders
